source: Distilled from published chinaready.co insights and handbooks (verdicts below reference their source articles). Updated on the site's China-reachability test publication cadence; no live probing is performed by this dataset.
notes: Verdicts describe reachability from Mainland China networks without a VPN, for typical embed/API usage by a Western-built site.

blocked = fails or is unusably unreliable for the primary use case; slow = works but with material latency/throttling; degraded = core works with meaningful limitations; ok = no material China-specific issue.
forms_verdict applies to the form backend, not the front-end widget alone.

origins.label: Google Fonts CSS
origins.fix: Self-host fonts on your own origin (or a China-reachable mirror); this is the single most common cause of multi-second render blocking in China.

origins.label: Google Fonts files
origins.fix: Serve woff2/woff from your own origin or CDN bucket.

origins.label: Google Hosted Libraries
origins.fix: Vendor the library into your bundle or serve from your origin.

origins.label: Google (search/reCAPTCHA/oAuth)
origins.fix: Replace reCAPTCHA with a China-available alternative (e.g. GeeTest, Alibaba Captcha); use a different auth path or a China-side proxy for Google OAuth.

origins.label: reCAPTCHA mirror
origins.fix: Same as reCAPTCHA — use a China-available captcha service.

origins.label: Google Maps JS API
origins.fix: Use Amap (Gaode) or Tencent Maps for China visitors; Google Maps tiles do not render reliably.

origins.label: Google Tag Manager
origins.fix: Remove for China traffic or self-host the container; pair with a local analytics provider.

origins.label: Google Analytics
origins.fix: Use a China-reachable analytics provider (e.g. Baidu Tongji, Umami self-hosted in China) or accept a blind spot.

origins.label: YouTube embeds
origins.fix: Re-host video on a China CDN and embed a China-native player, or link out; WeChat Channels/Bilibili for reach.

origins.label: Vimeo player
origins.fix: Re-host on a China CDN for reliable playback; Vimeo often stalls or degrades.

origins.label: jsDelivr CDN
origins.fix: jsDelivr has China nodes but availability fluctuates; for production, vendor assets or use a China CDN.

origins.label: cdnjs
origins.fix: Generally reachable but cross-border latency; vendor for production.

origins.label: unpkg
origins.fix: Cross-border latency and occasional timeouts; vendor for production.

origins.label: Adobe Typekit
origins.fix: Self-host if China traffic matters; delivery is cross-border and can stall.

origins.label: Firebase Realtime DB
origins.fix: Firebase has no China region; move the data path to a China-hosted equivalent (see Firebase alternatives article).

origins.label: Firebase Storage
origins.fix: Migrate assets to a China object store with CDN.

origins.label: Firebase (wildcard)
origins.fix: Same as firebaseio.com — no China region exists.

origins.label: Google Cloud Functions
origins.fix: Host the function in a China region on a China cloud, or proxy through one.

origins.label: Google APIs (generic)
origins.fix: Assume unreachable from China without a proxy; move the call server-side behind a China-reachable host.

origins.label: AWS S3 (us/std endpoints)
origins.fix: Cross-border reachability varies by bucket region and hour; for China production, front with a China CDN or mirror into OSS.

origins.label: AWS S3 (regional)
origins.fix: Same as s3.amazonaws.com; mirror into a China object store for production.

origins.label: GCS
origins.fix: Cross-border; mirror into OSS + China CDN.

origins.label: Azure Blob (global)
origins.fix: Global Azure is reachable but cross-border; Azure China (separate cloud) or OSS+CDN for production.

origins.label: Formspree-style form backends
origins.fix: Cross-border POST latency/failures; use a China-hosted form endpoint or function.

origins.label: HubSpot Forms API
origins.fix: HubSpot marketing scripts also carry trackers that stall in China; capture via a China-side endpoint and sync.

origins.label: HubSpot tracking scripts
origins.fix: Load conditionally for non-China visitors or self-host the minimal form API.

origins.label: Intercom widget
origins.fix: Widget loads cross-border and drags page load; consider a China-side chat or lazy-load for China visitors.

origins.label: Intercom API
origins.fix: Same as intercomcdn — slow or stalling for China visitors.

origins.label: Hotjar
origins.fix: Session replay uploads are heavy cross-border; disable for China or use a local tool.

origins.label: Segment
origins.fix: Event delivery cross-border; buffer server-side or use a China collector.

origins.label: Facebook SDK
origins.fix: Remove for China traffic; Facebook is unreachable.

origins.label: X/Twitter embeds
origins.fix: Replace with static screenshots/links; Twitter widgets do not load in China.

origins.label: Calendly
origins.fix: Widget loads cross-border; for China leads use a static form or a China-reachable booking page.

origins.label: Stripe JS
origins.fix: Stripe has no China acquiring; checkout loads but mainland cards largely fail — pair with a China payment rail.

origins.label: Stripe Checkout
origins.fix: Same as Stripe JS; expect mainland-card declines.

origins.label: Cloudflare Turnstile
origins.fix: Turnstile generally completes in China but can stall; test from mainland networks before relying on it for lead forms.

origins.label: Disqus
origins.fix: Use a China-native comment system or none; Disqus does not load.

origins.label: Mozilla public CDN
origins.fix: Cross-border; vendor for production.

origins.label: WordPress.com assets
origins.fix: WordPress.com is unreachable from China; self-host assets if the blog must serve China.

origins.label: WordPress photon CDN
origins.fix: Same family as WordPress.com — unreachable; move images.

forms.guidance: A form that POSTs to an overseas endpoint is the last thing to break and the most expensive when it does: submissions cross the border twice (load + POST) with no retry. Captcha choice matters as much as the backend — reCAPTCHA blocks the form outright.

unknown_origin_note: Origins not in this dataset get verdict 'unknown' — absence of evidence is not evidence of reachability. Chinaready maintains a wider tested set; ask.
